name: @vigilia/editor
description: Desktop authoring experience. Adds interaction overlays and inspectors on top of the shared renderer.
//: ADR-0005: the editor is an interaction and inspector layer over @vigilia/renderer-core. Both Fabric candidates were rejected — they are canvas editors, and this renderer is DOM plus ECharts, so adopting one meant rendering the scene twice (§31 forbids it; Gate 0 rejects it outright). Do NOT add a Fabric dependency. No UI framework yet either: one is worth adding when the inspector surface is real enough to judge the trade, and adding it first would be choosing whatever got installed first.
